theorems.name: Submission.p04_tia_homology_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (n : ℕ), ∃ T : groupHomology A n →ₗ[k] groupHomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n, ∃ P : groupHomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n →ₗ[k] groupHomology A n, ∀ x : groupHomology A n, P (T x) = H.index • x
